name: Barachoda Bloom
source:
You have just traveled to Bangladesh for a work-related project. As it turns out, Bangladesh happens to be your country of heritage. You rush into the place you'll be staying for several months when you bump into someone familiar. It's your childhood friend who you haven't seen in person for at least a decade. The two of you reconnect a day later, and he asks you to do one thing. Make more friends. You're more interested in finding more men to bang, but as you learn more about the country's inhabitants, you start to wonder if he has a point.

Barachoda Bloom is a dating sim where you get to know several beefy men, see a loser become his ideal self, and find your true love out of these men. You play as said loser (default name is Rahmir Ayaz) who thinks about doing dudes more than anything else. But he's also terribly lacking in social skills and thoughtfulness due to some baggage he had during his childhood. During his stay in Bangladesh, he has the chance to befriend several men, and he slowly learns how to become more sociable and thoughtful by spending time with these men. And if you allow him, he can start a relationship with one of these men, but can he prove himself worthy for such a thing?

[From [url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/barachoda-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚前往孟加拉国参加一个与工作相关的项目。事实证明，孟加拉国恰好是你的祖国。当你冲进你将要住几个月的地方时，你遇到了一个熟悉的人。这是你儿时的朋友，你至少有十年没有见过面了。一天后你们两个重新联系，他要求你做一件事。结交更多朋友。你更感兴趣的是找到更多的男人来干，但当你对这个国家的居民了解得更多时，你开始怀疑他的观点是否有道理。

Barachoda Bloom是一款约会模拟游戏，你可以在其中认识几个强壮的男人，看到一个失败者成为他理想的自己，并从这些男人中找到你的真爱。你扮演的是所谓的失败者（默认名字是拉赫米尔·阿亚兹），他最想的是和男人打交道。但由于童年时的一些包袱，他也非常缺乏社交能力和体贴。在孟加拉国逗留期间，他有机会与几个男人成为朋友，他慢慢学会了如何通过与这些男人相处而变得更加善于交际和体贴。如果你允许他，他可以与其中一个男人建立关系，但他能证明自己值得做这样的事情吗？

[来自[url=https://chellaytiger.itch.io/barachoda-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
